business_problem: MUFG needed to modernize banking operations and customer experiences with AI while satisfying the governance, security, training, and trust requirements expected of a major financial institution.
solution_summary: MUFG is using OpenAI as the foundation for an AI-native banking model that starts with secure internal adoption and extends toward customer-facing financial guidance. The first layer is a phased ChatGPT Enterprise rollout across Mitsubishi UFJ Bank so roughly 35,000 employees can use AI in daily work under mandatory training, security controls, and clear usage rules. OpenAI supported operational planning, workshops, executive education, custom GPT materials, and banking-specific examples, while MUFG created department-level AI champions and more than 1,800 custom GPTs, including “AI bankers” tailored to local workflows. Beyond internal productivity, MUFG is preparing customer experiences around Apps in ChatGPT and its digital-bank ecosystem, including Moneytree, an AI concierge, and the MAP advisory platform so users can ask natural-language questions about balances, transactions, and personalized financial recommendations.

solution_components.name: ChatGPT Enterprise
solution_components.role: Provides the secure enterprise AI workspace MUFG is rolling out across Mitsubishi UFJ Bank.

solution_components.name: AI bankers
solution_components.role: Custom GPTs tailored by departments to automate routine work and surface specialized knowledge.

solution_components.name: Moneytree in Apps in ChatGPT
solution_components.role: Lets users ask natural-language questions and view balances and transaction details from within ChatGPT.

solution_components.name: MAP (Money Advisory Platform)
solution_components.role: Is being prepared to deliver personalized financial recommendations based on each customer’s life stage.

data_flow: Employee tasks and internal banking workflows flow into ChatGPT Enterprise and department-specific AI bankers under governance controls and mandatory training. Customer financial data is then intended to surface through Moneytree and MAP so conversational queries can return balances, transactions, and personalized recommendations inside MUFG’s digital-bank experiences.
business_outcome: MUFG established the operating model for large-scale bank-wide AI use, trained every enrolled employee, saw rapid custom-GPT creation, reduced workload on selected research tasks, and laid the groundwork for always-available conversational financial guidance.
